anchor.description: Exact paragraph anchor supplied in the prompt.

translation.description: Faithful Chinese translation, or an empty string when translation is disabled.

role.description: What this passage does in the paper's argument.

context.description: How this passage connects to neighbouring passages or the paper-level argument.

explanation.description: Substantive explanation that goes beyond paraphrase.

takeaway.description: What a reader should retain after reading the passage.

caveat.description: A source-grounded limitation, ambiguity, or an explicit statement that no caveat is needed.
